description: Get the embed HTML and metadata for a public Threads post, for rendering a rich preview on an external site. No access token required.

maxwidth.description: Maximum width of the returned embed in pixels (320-658)

url.description: Permalink of the post, e.g. https://www.threads.com/@user/post/{shortcode} or https://www.threads.com/t/{shortcode}

name: threads_get_oembed
